purpose: Opt-in validation-first ownership entrypoint for explicitly grounded assignments; preserve frozen rc.4 and legacy behavior
scientific_basis: Existing opt-in GroundedRiskResponsibility and named distinct Endurant evidence contract
SR-REL-028 expresses the participant/mediation side toward an actor/role bearer
Current gUFO Type and Individual are disjoint; OWL class/individual punning alone is not forbidden
scope: Only explicitly selected GroundedRiskResponsibility records yield guarded answers; no universal actor identity, real authority or complete FAP-006 guarantee

input_contract.local_format: Turtle data file; reject owl:imports in data before any reasoner call
input_contract.typing: Require explicit ac:GroundedRiskResponsibility AND SR-CPT-031 for each opted-in assignment; no hidden subclass inference
input_contract.assignee: Explicit gufo:Endurant evidence and membership among gufo:mediates values
input_contract.counterpart: Existing shape requires another explicitly different mediated Endurant and excludes sameAs paths
input_contract.risk: Aboutness target, never invented as a mediated participant
input_contract.as_of: Required four-digit-year dateTime with T separator, seconds and explicit Z or timezone offset within the XML Schema range; parse actual calendar/time validity. No implicit wall-clock default.
input_contract.legacy: Non-opted assignments are not returned and are reported as excluded from grounding scope; frozen query/profile remain unchanged
input_contract.no_opted_records: Return NOT_APPLICABLE with consistency NOT_ASSESSED and no owners field; no consistency or grounded-validation claim is made for a legacy-only graph.
input_contract.validation_scope: Extract the unchanged constraint closure of the temporal ResponsibilityShape and optional GroundedResponsibilityShape; retarget only their targets to the explicitly opted assignment nodes. Add the new membership/type-entry shape. Other unrelated profile targets are not activated.
input_contract.consistency_scope: For applicable input with opted records, the entire supplied local data graph plus pinned current ontology must be consistent before any validated result. Non-opted shape exclusion never excludes that data from this consistency check.

pipeline: Verify pinned source/tool bytes and caller input contract
Compose frozen temporal and optional grounding shapes with one separately versioned assignee-membership/type-entry constraint; MetaSHACL true, inference none
On any shape failure, return explicit VALIDATION_FAILED with no owners field
Check OWL 2 DL and actual HermiT consistency against pinned eight-file closure; reject tool/profile/consistency failures explicitly
Only after successful validation run the frozen ownership SELECT plus an explicit GroundedRiskResponsibility filter
Report bounded owner pairs, opted/legacy assignment counts and unknown-start IDs; never equate no answers with universal absence of owners
positive_fixture: New synthetic person/organization placeholders are Endurants without adopting actor kinds. Two opted assignments overlap at an explicit boundary; a third Endurant supports isolated missing-assignee-mediation control. One legacy assignment remains outside opted scope.
positive_controls: Counterpart mediation alone creates no owner answer
Benign OWL class/individual punning without gufo Type conflict is not blacklisted
Valid opted assignment with unknown start is reported but excluded from as-of answers
Frozen legacy query behavior remains unchanged, including its documented permissive class-token limitation

Mixed input with a non-opted assignment missing application fields: scoped shapes do not validate it, it contributes no guarded answer, and exclusion is reported. The whole input still must be OWL-consistent.
Legacy-only inconsistent data still returns NOT_APPLICABLE with consistency NOT_ASSESSED and no owners, not a false validation success.
negative_controls: Bare known Risk Owner class IRI rejected at explicit Endurant validation
Same known RoleMixin falsely asserted Endurant passes shape stage but fails actual gUFO consistency
Missing explicit parent responsibility type rejected before query
Assignee omitted from mediation while two other Endurants remain: old shape conforms, new membership constraint rejects
Missing counterpart or explicit differentFrom rejected
Event participant rejected; event falsely typed Endurant rejected through consistency
sameAs alias cannot be second witness
Reversed interval and missing timezone rejected
Data owl:imports rejected without external fetching
Invalid cases never return an owners field or misleading empty success answer
Mixed opted records plus a logically inconsistent non-opted record fail whole-input consistency.
retained_limits: Legacy profile is not silently strengthened
No mandatory external actor taxonomy or authoritative actor registry
No canonical ontology, historical shape/query, SQL, manuscript or deployment changes
Full FAP-006 and all other full-antipattern verdicts remain NOT_ESTABLISHED
answer_oracle: Compare sorted complete (risk, actor) tuples formed from the fixed risk IRI and actor namespace; actor-only membership is insufficient.
mock_boundary: Mocks verify fail-closed software branches only and are reported separately from actual formal results.
